svg.title: Watching one search find its mapping
svg.desc: A line of ten points showing the PE utilisation of each mapping a real search tried, labelled with its dataflow per stage. The run reaches input-stationary, weight-stationary, output-stationary at step four, above the exhaustive per-stage static baseline.

g.text: best single dataflow for the whole workload (OS) — 78.91

text.tspan: Three of the five seeds land on this same IS·WS·OS mapping —
the per-stage choice that the exhaustive static search also makes.
